name: slicc-jerk
description: Get, list, create and drop OAuth tokens across operating systems and inside SLICC, by dispatching to each provider's own CLI

scripts.lint: slicc-lint && shellcheck scripts/*.sh && shellcheck -s sh install.sh && cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.typecheck: node --check npm/jerk.js && node --check scripts/targets.mjs && node --check scripts/npm-stage.mjs && node --check scripts/npm-publish.mjs && node --check scripts/release-plan.mjs && node --check scripts/release-collect.mjs && node --check scripts/build-wasm.mjs && node --check scripts/build-matrix.mjs && node --check scripts/build-jerk-oauth-wasm.mjs
scripts.test:unit: mkdir -p coverage/unit && RUSTFLAGS='--cfg jerk_unit' cargo llvm-cov --workspace --exclude jerk-oauth-wasm --lcov --output-path coverage/unit/lcov.info --ignore-filename-regex '(crates/jerk/src/main\.rs|test/unit/|keyring_store\.rs|browser\.rs|default_host\.rs)'
